1879060771.name: Light of Hope
1879060771.desc: Transfers Morale to an ally or companion.

1879073571.name: Eldar's Grace
1879073571.desc: With the speed and grace of the Eldar, you can put up a strong parry defence.

1879073699.name: Punctured Target
1879073699.desc: A sharpened arrow that can pierce armour.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Ignores 30% of your target's mitigations</rgb>

1879094819.name: Improved Warding Knowledge
1879094819.desc:
Creates a circle in which enemies are vulnerable to tactical damage and more likely to miss.

Circle remains for 1 minute.

Affects the following:
Dead, Unseen, Creatures of Nature, and Insects.

1879096867.name: Scribe Manual: Clarinet
1879096867.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the clarinet. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879139747.name: Grasping Web
1879139747.desc:
A web attack that roots several targets in place. <rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879197731.name: Staff Sweep
1879197731.desc: Sweeps the staff to strike surrounding foes.

1879209891.name: Steed of the Captain
1879209891.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the captain.

1879226915.name: Ring of Frost
1879226915.desc: Utilize the power of Frost to counter Saruman's attempts to drain this ring of its power.

1879231267.name: Fist and Fist
1879231267.desc: Mastery over the Fist: Allows Warden to perform Fist Gambits quickly.

1879231395.name: Ranged  Boot
1879231395.desc: A blunt javelin interrupts inductions.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241635.name: Call of the Eorlingas
1879241635.desc: Your Call greatly heartens a rider and their war-steed.

1879243939.name: Improved Wild Attack
1879243939.desc: You make a powerful melee attack, followed by a quick off-hand swipe. Critical Hits will increase your Critical Hit chance for a short period of time.

1879244195.name: Coax
1879244195.desc: You issue forth a mighty scream taunting your enemy and coaxing them to ride alongside of you.

1879277987.name: Concession and Rebuttal: Sustaining Bolt
1879277987.desc: A rune-keeper knows that a storm's energy is capable of feeding itself.\n\nThis skill is stronger when used at greater Battle Attunement.

1879288483.name: Stealthed Ambush of Light
1879288483.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879342115.name: Muster in Haerondir
1879342115.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Haerondir.

1879360803.name: Plateau Mole-rat
1879360803.desc: Brings out a plateau mole-rat to keep you company.

1879365411.name: Smaug Kite
1879365411.desc: Brings out a Smaug kite to keep you company.

1879406755.name: Orange Wyandotte Carrying Chicken
1879406755.desc: Carry around your prized orange Wyandotte chicken.

1879415715.name: Obvious Portent of Deftness
1879415715.desc: A quick burst of defence, absorbing a portion of damage dealt to you.

1879459363.name: Test Melee Common
1879459363.desc: Does fixed common damage to test buffs and mitigations.

1879467811.name: Nature's Wrath (Dual)
1879467811.desc: You maul the enemy with a furious attack, gaining Wrath.

1879490723.name: Fierce Hedgehog
1879490723.desc: Summons a fierce hedgehog to accompany you on your travels.

1879508003.name: Hail of Arrows
1879508003.desc: Loose a hail of arrows, which tear through the armour of a large group of enemies.

1879516451.name: Slink Away
1879516451.desc: When your enemies attempt to pin you down, you deftly evade their grasp and briefly melt into the shadows.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Being slowed by a skill or effect will not allow this skill use.</rgb>

1879522083.name: Behold: My Treasure Hauler
1879522083.desc: Summon your treasure waggon to awe and impress - does not come fully loaded.

1879524387.name: Daffodil Celebration Kid
1879524387.desc: Summons a cheerful daffodil loving goat kid to accompany you on your travels.
